_comment: ARS (Autonomy Risk Score) priors — the deterministic data behind `aidlc-graph.ts ars`. Single source of truth for the component weights, band boundaries, stage cost priors, and EV thresholds that previously lived as prose arithmetic in the composer persona; the persona's tables are now documentation of THIS file. All values are UNCALIBRATED priors: the composite is an advisory index for the human at the gate, and nothing deterministic routes on it. evThresholds carries the persona's shipped anchors (cost 1 → any non-zero component justifies, cost 2 → > 0.2, cost 4 → > 0.4); costs 3 and 5 are linear interpolation/extension (0.3, 0.5) pending calibration. Stages with `cost: null` (incident-response, feedback-optimization) have no row in the persona's cost-prior table — the screen reports them as not numerically screenable instead of inventing a cost. `role` marks stages the screen decides without component arithmetic: initialization (always run), core (spine — always), phase-gate (approval-handoff executes iff any other ideation stage executes), structural (decomposition judgment — mechanical default SKIP). `projectTypes` mirrors a stage's compiled `condition:` when that condition restricts the stage to one kind of project (reverse-engineering is brownfield-only): with `--project-type`, a stage outside the given type SKIPs regardless of its component scores, so the screen never contradicts the stage it would have to run.
